skill_fit.why: Says automation, means software engineering. He has never bid on one: 'engineer' in the title is 264 cards and 5 applications, 'agent(ic)' 245 and 2. Grade 2 is 'adjacent, and he does not take these'.

skill_fit.why: A different trade. 'voice' in the title is 90 cards and zero applications; marketing, funnel and content the same. Grade 1 is 'not his work at all' -- and note the old exemplar file graded THIS SHAPE a 4, which is a large part of why skill fit was scoring loose.

skill_fit.title: HubSpot Website & UX Specialist Needed for One-Time Website Review and Optimization

skill_fit.why: HubSpot in the title, website and UX design in the body. The platform is his; the trade is not. The same goes for HubSpot Marketing Hub campaign work, sequences, SDR and VA roles -- grade 1-2 whatever the platform. This is the other side of the HubSpot line and it matters as much as the grade-5 above.
